currency.basis: The favicon is the currently served site icon of the operating tonscan.org site, retrieved 2026-10-04.

identity.basis: Asset is served from tonscan.org itself and declared as the site icon in the homepage HTML of tonscan.org, the URL recorded for Company.id 16062.

assessment.independenceRationale: Single official primary source (site + its declared icon are one publication); no independent third-party corroboration was sought because the official domain directly serves the asset and matches the record URL.

variant.basis: The site publishes a single mark (favicon.svg plus mask-icon pointing to the same file); no competing variant was observed.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All source details survive: outline stroke, ears, eyes and nose are present and correctly shaped in the final Desktop renders; alpha ~85% is preserved (translucent face visible on both themes).
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Square 32x32 viewBox preserved without scaling; the emblem fills the cell with even margins as in the source; useful size at 24/32/48 px diagnostics retains recognition.
candidate.rationale: Replace the unrelated accepted glyph with the official current TonScan mark served at tonscan.org/favicon.svg; identity, currency and variant of the fetched asset are confirmed against the official domain.
candidate.role: standalone site-icon mark of the operating tonscan.org service
transforms: Resolved the source stylesheet's light-theme paints to identical values in 8-digit hex notation: stroke/fill rgba(0,0,0,0.85) -> #000000D9, face fill rgba(255,255,255,0.85) -> #FFFFFFD9; no color or geometry change

Removed the source <style> element (currentColor and dark-mode media query unsupported by the pinned converter); dark-theme source variant not reproducible in one static file, light-theme values chosen
SVGO (repository svgo.config.mjs): 1068 -> 1039 bytes on the hex-notation copy, output visually identical on both themes; selected the optimized result as final.svg
No geometric transform, scaling or backing added; source 32x32 viewBox preserved
candidate.variant: light-theme favicon variant: dark outline and features over translucent white face fill; no backing field (transparent standalone mark)
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: The accepted icon shows a completely different glyph (white plus-like symbol on a blue circular field); the replacement shows the official TonScan cat-face mark. The change is a full symbol and color correction, not a cosmetic reserialization.

proposals.reason: Official tonscan.org favicon.svg (declared via <link rel=icon> on the homepage, fetched from the official domain) shows a stylized cat-face mark with dark outline, white face fill and dark eyes/mouth. The accepted icon.svg is an unrelated white plus-like glyph on a blue circular field that matches no TonScan-published asset; the official mark differs visibly in symbol and colors, so a supported replacement is proposed.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector (official favicon.svg, real SVG paths, no raster) of the current official TonScan mark; the accepted icon depicts a different glyph and fails identity against the official asset.

sources.observation: Homepage declares <link rel=icon href=/favicon.svg>; the fetched SVG (712 bytes, gzip transfer) is a standalone 32x32 viewBox mark (cat-like head, currentColor strokes plus stylesheet with light/dark values and .head white fill). Rendered independently with rsvg-convert on white: dark outline, white face, dark eyes/nose.
